title_en: You may get a free lawyer
law: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, Sections 12 and 13
rule_plain: Some people get free legal help for a court case. This includes women and children, SC and ST people, people with disability, victims of trafficking or disasters, industrial workers, people in custody, and people with low income. In Tamil Nadu, the income limit is Rs 3,00,000 a year for cases in courts other than the Supreme Court. Legal aid is fully free, and the form is free too.
what_you_can_do: Call the NALSA helpline 15100 (toll-free) for urgent legal help.
Go to the District Legal Services Authority in the District Court, or the Taluk Legal Services Committee in your taluk court.
You can apply in person, by post, by e-mail or online on the NALSA LSMS portal.
You can give a sworn statement (affidavit) about your income.
where_to_get_help: NALSA helpline 15100; District Legal Services Authority (District Court) or Taluk Legal Services Committee; Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority.
